chunks: Had they really been gods they would not have entered it: They will all abide in it for ever.
ai.seo_question: Why are the false gods of polytheism in Hell according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse employs the logical principle of 'incompatibility of opposites' to refute polytheism: if these idols possessed independent divine power, they would not be subject to the same punishment as humans. The phrase 'all therein will abide eternally' underscores the permanence of their defeat, serving as a definitive proof of Allah's absolute uniqueness (Tawhid) and the futility of associating partners with Him. This argument is often cited by scholars like Allamah Tabatabai to demonstrate that true divinity implies self-sufficiency and immunity from destruction.
